section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes translation of questionnaires into Danish, Portuguese, and Swedish using back-translation and pilot testing in the target audiences. Pilot testing involved two boys and two girls (aged 12–19) recruited by country who were interviewed to assess item clarity; participants reported BAS-2 items were clear. No study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') or statistical results (e.g., BMI, correlations) are reported in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: "The questionnaires which were not available in Danish, Portuguese, and Swedish were translated in the respective languages following the back-translation technique (Brislin, 1970)."; "The translation procedure was followed by a pilot testing of the questionnaires in the target audience. Two boys and two girls from 12 to 19 years old were recruited by country."; "These students indicated that all BAS-2 items made sense and were clear and easy to understand."
